purpose: Predeclare the corrected Dense weight-space summaries and retrieval bridge before the first corrected checkpoint exists.

visibility_at_freeze.observed_corrected_state: Two AdamW runs were in progress below checkpoint-782; no corrected checkpoint directory was deeply resumable.

weight_space.scope: The 88 hidden two-dimensional matrices routed to the main optimizer; auxiliary embeddings, pooling, norms, and biases are excluded from the headline geometry.
weight_space.saved_segment_definition: At stage 1, checkpoint weight minus the pinned pretrained initialization. At stages 2-5, current checkpoint weight minus the preceding retained checkpoint weight.
weight_space.cumulative_definition: Checkpoint weight minus the pinned pretrained initialization.
weight_space.terminology_boundary: Saved-segment displacement is a coarse parameter displacement over many optimizer steps. It is not an instantaneous update, the sum of per-step update norms, or optimizer path length.
per_checkpoint_metrics: saved-segment Frobenius norm and segment-to-weight ratio
cumulative displacement Frobenius norm and displacement-to-weight ratio
parameter-weighted stable rank and stable-rank fraction
parameter-weighted top-64 sketch entropy effective rank and rank fraction
row-norm coefficient of variation and top-1-percent row energy
fraction of hidden parameters with nonzero saved displacement after checkpoint serialization
weight_space.subspace_metric: For every unordered run pair at the same stage and displacement kind, compute rank-16 randomized left and right singular bases per hidden matrix. Normalize squared Frobenius canonical overlap by retained rank, average left and right, then parameter-weight across tensors for which both displacements are nonzero.
weight_space.zero_displacement_rule: A matrix with exactly zero serialized displacement has undefined singular subspace. Exclude it from overlap numerators and denominators and report the defined-parameter fraction; never impute zero or one overlap.
weight_space.rate_pair_policy: Compute all unordered run pairs. For optimizer-pair summaries, average all available learning-rate pairs equally without BEIR or validation selection.

retrieval_bridge.outcome: mean decontaminated BEIR nDCG@10 over the 14 pinned tasks at the same checkpoint
features: mean saved-segment subspace overlap to all AdamW rates at the same stage
mean cumulative subspace overlap to all AdamW rates at the same stage
retrieval_bridge.adamw_overlap_rule: For Muon and NorMuon rows average overlap to all four AdamW rates. For an AdamW row average the other three AdamW rates, excluding self-comparison.
retrieval_bridge.prediction_test: For each feature separately, compare a baseline containing optimizer indicators, stage indicators, and within-optimizer centered log10 learning rate with the same model plus the feature. Use four leave-dose-index-out folds, holding out the corresponding ordered learning-rate index for every optimizer and all stages.
retrieval_bridge.support_rule: Call a feature predictively useful only if adding it lowers pooled held-out RMSE and lowers RMSE in at least three of four folds. Report every feature and fold; do not select a feature for the paper based only on the pooled score.
retrieval_bridge.association_table: Also report Pearson and Spearman associations after residualizing outcome and each feature on the locked baseline. These are descriptive and are not a substitute for held-out prediction.
retrieval_bridge.claim_boundary: This is one-seed, post-diagnosis mechanism triangulation. It can show whether geometry tracks or predicts retrieval variation beyond the locked baseline in this grid; it cannot identify mediation, prove causality, or generalize beyond the pinned model/data/optimizer grids.

publication_only_amendment.reason: Rebind the shared aggregator after removing a retired parallel Markdown article interface. Geometry definitions, bridge features, folds, support thresholds, and inference inputs are unchanged.

historical_bridge.rule: Compare corrected and historical optimizer rankings and optimizer-minus-AdamW deltas descriptively at matched normalized stages. Do not pool checkpoints or use historical results in corrected inference.
historical_bridge.interpretation: A ranking change is execution-path sensitivity evidence, not a new randomized factor or a causal estimate of packing.
